headline: Easy breeding chain: Azurobe
title: Easy Azurobe Breeding Chain in Palworld | 3 Steps From Easy Pals | Palworld Breeding Guide
video_script: Want Azurobe to ride across the water? Follow these three easy breeding steps. Step one: breed Tocotoco with Vanwyrm to get Dazemu. Step two: breed that Dazemu with Lovander to get Sweepa. Step three: breed that Sweepa with Bushi, and the egg hatches into Azurobe! Every step is checked against Palworld one point zero breeding data. Put each pair on the Breeding Farm with a cake. Which Pal should I chain next? Comment below!
description: Easy 3-step Palworld 1.0 breeding chain to Azurobe: Tocotoco + Vanwyrm = Dazemu, Dazemu + Lovander = Sweepa, Sweepa + Bushi = Azurobe. Each step verified on PalBreedCalc and with the breeding formula from PinDrop's combi ranks.
